dog.description_text: The staff at the ASPCA Adoption Center are hard at work getting to know this furry friend and will post more information shortly! In the meantime, you can meet available cats and dogs by visiting the Adoption Center. You can also submit an adoption survey for this pet or any of our other adoptable pets. *You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 5 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
dog.name: SPRITZ
